examples_in_actual_prompt.question: 查询所有黑色且为货车的车辆

steps.query: SELECT plate_number FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE v.color = '黑' AND t.type_name = '货车';
